stories.title: Director prosecuted after Bagillt waste site repeatedly breached its environmental permit
stories.summary: A former waste company director has been sentenced after a site at Dee Bank Industrial Estate in Bagillt carried on operating after Natural Resources Wales ordered it to stop. Oliver Kirkbride, former director of GTR Aggregates & Recycling Ltd and then Think Aggregates & Recycling Ltd, pleaded guilty and was sentenced on Friday 14 August.

stories.title: Home Office changes Gronant asylum seeker housing plan after review
